Hello Remixers!

Scrunch has an annoying bug that breaks the high score system when you remix a project.

Here's how you can fix it so it will work again.


1. Click on the orange 'Variables' blocks on the left side of the screen.

2. Find the variables named "☁ HS-1" to "☁ HS-7"

3. Right click on them and choose 'Rename Variable'

4. Rename all of the ☁ variables by adding a letter to the end of the name.

5. You're done. It should work again!!!



Bonus Step. To reset the high scores - go to the sprite called 'High Scores' and find the note there.


See you later!
Love from
Castle_Hippopotamus
